subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted context, through plugin-hook metadata, or persisted on session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is technically bounded, but the requested value is an advertising click identifier and the issue asks for agent/session exposure, so automation should not choose visibility and retention policy.

options.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
options.body: Expose a typed WhatsApp attribution payload to opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier in every model prompt.

options.title: Per-Turn Untrusted Context
options.body: Extract the CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Persist Session Attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after maintainers define retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
recommendation.body: Expose a typed WhatsApp attribution payload to opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier in every model prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent structured-context, plugin SDK, and session-metadata history is the closest match for the unresolved visibility and retention decision.
